summary: Stillwater County, MT crow's nest on the Custer NF, listed for 1938 and abandoned in 1950; sources conflict on the forest, and nothing describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1950; no source describes what remains on the butte today.

Forest Lookouts page header names Custer National Forest

corrections.why: The Forest Fire Lookout Association list gives Limestone Butte as Abandoned, not Gone; firelookout.com says it was abandoned in 1950 and does not say the structure is gone

notes_for_editor: Two open problems. (1) Forest and location: firelookout.com, the association list and the record put the butte in Stillwater County on the Custer NF. The Forest Lookouts page carries a 1940 NGS station description of a Limestone lookout in the Flathead NF near Spotted Bear and Bear River, which may be a different structure. Not resolved; the story follows the Stillwater sources. (2) Status: the record says gone, but the association list says Abandoned; the correction above is for editor review. Kind: the record says platform, and the sources say crow's nest (association type Crowsnest); left unchanged. No staffing, fire history or present-day description was found.
